description: An immersive learning journey through everyday life experiences

missions.title: Airport Arrival
missions.objective: Master basic interactions at customs and baggage claim.

episodes.title: Passport Control
episodes.objective: Learn to present ID and answer basic entry questions.

episodes.title: Customs Questions
episodes.objective: Learn to answer customs officer's questions about duration of stay and accommodation.

episodes.title: Baggage Claim
episodes.objective: Learn to understand airport announcements and report lost luggage.

episodes.title: Airport Exit
episodes.objective: Learn to ask for directions and order a taxi to leave the airport.

missions.title: At the Café
missions.objective: Learn to order food and drinks, make small talk with locals.

episodes.title: Ordering at the Counter
episodes.objective: Learn to order coffee and pastries using polite expressions.

episodes.title: Paying the Bill
episodes.objective: Learn to ask for the bill and handle payment interactions.

missions.title: Using Public Transport
missions.objective: Navigate the metro system, buy tickets, ask for directions.

episodes.title: Buying a Metro Ticket
episodes.objective: Learn to purchase tickets and understand pricing options.

episodes.title: Asking for Directions
episodes.objective: Learn to ask which line to take and where to transfer.
